description: Campus Market Intelligence scoring configuration. All weights and thresholds live here so the model can be re-tuned without touching pipeline or UI code. Scores are 0-100, percentile-normalized across the matched target universe so absolute size does not blow out the scale.

data_sources.completions: IPEDS Completions survey (C{year}_A), AWLEVEL=5 (bachelor's), MAJORNUM=1 (first majors). CIP 99=total, CIP 52.*=business, CIP 52.03*=accounting.
data_sources.enrollment_12mo: IPEDS EFFY EFFYLEV=2 (12-month unduplicated undergraduate) for trend.
data_sources.directory: IPEDS HD2023 (UNITID, name, state, city, control).

intro1_estimate.label: ESTIMATED, NOT ACTUAL ENROLLMENT
intro1_estimate.rationale: Annual business bachelor's completions x multiplier approximates the yearly Intro Financial Accounting seat pool. The multiplier accounts for: business majors nearly all pass through Intro Financial Accounting; students who start business and switch out; business minors and adjacent majors (econ, IS) who take intro; and retakes. 2.4 is a deliberately conservative placeholder. Recalibrate against real course-enrollment samples when available; store per-campus overrides rather than editing this default.

growth.min_denominator_handling: A growth RATE for a window only counts if that window's baseline business completions >= min_base_business (25). Below that the rate is statistically noise (e.g. 2->10, 0->25 new programs) and is excluded from the momentum score rather than allowed to top the ranking. Share change is additionally damped by a small-market size factor.
growth.meaningful_market: latest_business_bachelors >= meaningful_market_min_business. Required for the RAPID_GROWTH label and for the 'fastest-growing meaningful markets' output lists, so a tiny program cannot headline growth.
growth.small_market_size_factor: min(1, latest_business_bachelors / min_base_business) applied to share-change and enrollment-trend signals.

distribution_strength_v1.note: Components not yet researched are EXCLUDED (not scored as zero); available weights are renormalized to 100%. distribution_data_completeness = sum(available weights). Recompute after the structural Campus Backfill settles.

live_demand_v1.note: First-party demand events (landing_page_events, orders, campus_waitlist, practice_attempts) exist but are too sparse and partially unattributed (practice_attempts has free-text campus, no campus_id) to score reliably universe-wide in V1. Raw first-party signal counts are exposed per campus for transparency; live_demand_score is null and carries zero weight until a real analytics feed (e.g. PostHog) is connected.

course_readiness_v1.note: Designed into the model for Course Intel to plug in later. Contributes ZERO weight to Outreach Priority in V1.

outreach_priority_v1.note: MARKET score, separate from CURRENT ACTION PRIORITY. Suppressions/guardrails (opt-out, unsubscribed, ineligible, recently contacted, active conversation) are applied as a separate action layer, never baked into this score.

enrichment_priority_v1.note: Which valuable campuses still have important missing structural data. enrichment_priority = market_opportunity_score * (1 - structural_completeness). NOT the same as outreach priority: a high-market campus with low structural completeness is a top ENRICHMENT target but not yet the best outreach target.

action_guardrails_v1.note: Applied to derive CURRENT ACTION PRIORITY from OUTREACH PRIORITY. Kept separate from the market score.
